description: This file defines a React component `ActionList` that renders a list of actions (likely trace events) in a trace viewer UI, along with related utility functions for rendering action items with detailed titles and metadata. It imports several modules for trace data, utilities, and UI components, and manages tree state, selection, and rendering logic for action trace events in a structured view.

methods.name: renderAction
methods.description: Renders an individual action trace event into a React node with optional UI elements such as duration, badges, attachments, and errors. It constructs the action title and iconography, and handles presentation logic based on parameters like showDuration, showBadges, showAttachments, and whether the trace is live.

methods.name: renderTitleForCall
methods.description: Generates a React node array and a string title for an action trace event by parsing the formatted title template, replacing protocol-specific placeholders with actual parameter representations, and creating clickable spans for parameters in the title.
